description: Use for the published Intel DCA ladder: what each plan (Defensive, Balanced, Growth) does on payday in each Score band (buy, save, or sell a set share once), word for word from btcintel.org/intel-dca/, with the notes under the ladder. With score, it returns the band and action each plan takes at that Score. Rules only: no personal plan, no advice, no backtest. For the Score to read the ladder against use get_score_for_day or get_score_live; for what the classifications mean get_methodology. Free.

plan.description: Return only this plan's ladder. Default: all three plans. All three sell from a Score of 60; Defensive buys and sells the smallest amounts, Growth the largest.

score.description: A Score from 0 to 100, for example one from get_score_for_day. Returns the band it falls in and that band's payday action for each plan (or the one plan named). Default: the full ladder.

name: get_plan_rules

plans.description: Each plan: its name and the action at each Score level, with the notes under the ladder

title: Intel DCA plan rules
